profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of shipping high-quality enterprise software. 8 years of software engineering experience - 5 in big tech, 3 at a startup. Has lead teams and projects through all phases of the design and development lifecycle. Has shipped software that has led directly to tens of millions in customer ACV. An all around fun, hard-working, authentic team player.

Skilled in Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, and SQL. Scrum Leader and Agile enthusiast. BS in Computer Science and a Mathematics Minor from University of Arizona.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
